Base.xcconfig.text:
PRODUCT_NAME = VezhamBrowser
PRODUCT_BUNDLE_IDENTIFIER = internal.vezham.browser.foundation
MACOSX_DEPLOYMENT_TARGET = 26.0
SDKROOT = macosx
SUPPORTED_PLATFORMS = macosx
SWIFT_VERSION = 6.0
INFOPLIST_FILE = Config/Info.plist
GENERATE_INFOPLIST_FILE = NO
CODE_SIGN_STYLE = Manual
CODE_SIGN_ENTITLEMENTS = Config/VezhamBrowser.entitlements
CODE_SIGN_INJECT_BASE_ENTITLEMENTS = NO
ENABLE_APP_SANDBOX = YES
ENABLE_HARDENED_RUNTIME = YES
ENABLE_USER_SCRIPT_SANDBOXING = YES
ENABLE_DEBUG_DYLIB = NO
CLANG_ENABLE_MODULES = YES
SWIFT_EMIT_LOC_STRINGS = NO
// vx-bot/NOTE: Keep runtime in the actual ad-hoc signature when base entitlement injection is disabled.
OTHER_CODE_SIGN_FLAGS = $(inherited) --options runtime

Info.plist.text:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE plist PUBLIC "-//Apple//DTD PLIST 1.0//EN" "http://www.apple.com/DTDs/PropertyList-1.0.dtd">
<plist version="1.0">
<dict>
    <key>CFBundleDevelopmentRegion</key><string>en</string>
    <key>CFBundleExecutable</key><string>$(EXECUTABLE_NAME)</string>
    <key>CFBundleIdentifier</key><string>$(PRODUCT_BUNDLE_IDENTIFIER)</string>
    <key>CFBundleInfoDictionaryVersion</key><string>6.0</string>
    <key>CFBundleName</key><string>Vezham Browser</string>
    <key>CFBundlePackageType</key><string>APPL</string>
    <key>CFBundleShortVersionString</key><string>0.1.0</string>
    <key>CFBundleVersion</key><string>1</string>
    <key>LSMinimumSystemVersion</key><string>$(MACOSX_DEPLOYMENT_TARGET)</string>
    <key>NSHighResolutionCapable</key><true/>
    <key>NSPrincipalClass</key><string>NSApplication</string>
</dict>
</plist>

blocker: Same-identity enumeration or Keychain ACL app requires a new reviewed executable/signing/native access scope; current instruction forbids signing and unapproved user actions.
